ID: `fontshare`.

## What it does

Compares 100 families and 59 official pairings against the brief, ranks alternatives and creates the requested samples in the available document. Distinguishes official data, editorial judgments and actual font availability.

## When to use it

Use it to choose typography for a logo, landing page, portal, branding or style guide, or to compare multiple families or pairings on the canvas.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/fontshare` in Claude Code or `$fontshare` in Codex. Provide the goal, art direction and number of alternatives; specify the document when you want visual samples. The skill uses existing context and asks only for missing decisions that change the selection.

## What it delivers

- Ranked shortlist with families, roles, styles, reasons and tradeoffs
- Samples in the requested document when the task calls for them
- Availability status and limitations observed during font verification

## Example

In the project file, create ten versions of the logo using ten Fontshare fonts, ranked by fit with the established art direction.

## Prerequisites

- For visual samples: an available document and editing tools
- Fonts actually accessible in the tool; for local apps, active OTF/TTF fonts
- For downloads: network, Python 3 and curl; no automatic permanent installation
